item.title: Claw machine offering chance to win New York trip coming to Enniskillen
item.description: Win a family trip to New York at Erneside Shopping Centre, Enniskillen! Enjoy festive claw machines, prizes, SuperValu & Centra events, and Christmas fun.

item.title: Trading Standards seize £22,000-worth of fake Lego and Labubus
item.description: Trading Standards Service (TSS) has recently seized more than £22,000-worth of fake toys, including Labubu dolls, K Pop Demon Hunters merchandise, Lego figures and Disney’s Lilo & Stitch products.

item.title: Police investigate 'serious assault' at bar
item.description: Police have launched an appeal for witnesses following a serious assault in a South Tyrone bar earlier this month.

item.title: Festive appeal for cats seeking new homes this Christmas
item.description: Bright Eyes Animal Sanctuary has issued a heartfelt appeal this week as seven of its long-term resident cats continue their search for permanent homes in time for the festive season.

item.title: Police probe repeated vandalism to property in Brookeborough
item.description: A property in the Grogey Road area of Brookeborough has had two incidents of vandalism in recent weeks.

item.title: One dead following single-vehicle crash in Lisnaskea
item.description: A 69-year-old man has died after a single-vehicle road traffic collision in Lisnaskea on Thursday afternoon.

item.title: Heavy rain to hit over the weekend as Met Office issue new weather warning
item.description: More rain is to hit Fermanagh over the weekend after a weather warning was issued by the Met Office for Sunday.

item.title: Shock expressed at death of 'well known' man in Lisnaskea crash
item.description: Politicians have expressed their ‘shock’ at the news of another death on Fermanagh’s roads.

item.title: How a Tyrone graduate 'turned struggle into strength'
item.description: Tanisha Wallace, from Dungannon, is graduating with a Master’s in Marketing from Queen’s University Belfast, having grappled with personal challenges, including mental health difficulties, to pursue a new-found passion.

item.title: Tributes flow to the late 'Fermanagh legend', Willie Boyd
item.description: Tributes have begun flowing this evening to the late Willie Boyd, fondly remembered by many as “a Fermanagh legend”. The late Mr. Boyd was a familiar face for many years in Lisnaskea, Enniskillen and all around the county, and could always be relied upon for a friendly chat with old friends and visitors to the area alike.
